description: This file implements internal global state management for OpenTelemetry, including global error handler, tracer provider, propagator, and meter provider, with thread-safe singleton patterns and configuration functions.

classes.name: errorHandlerHolder
classes.description: Holds an ErrorHandler instance for global error handling.

classes.name: tracerProviderHolder
classes.description: Holds a trace.TracerProvider for global tracing.

classes.name: propagatorsHolder
classes.description: Holds a propagation.TextMapPropagator for global context propagation.

classes.name: meterProviderHolder
classes.description: Holds a metric.MeterProvider for global metrics.

methods.name: SetErrorHandler
methods.description: Sets the global ErrorHandler to a new instance.
